correctness.rationale: The 4-regularity double-count yields exact nonnegative identity 2(3W-n)=2t+A+B, with t the count of double labels; this proves known gamma and bounds t<=2 for minimizers. The case t=2 forces n=10, t=1 forces n=5 or contradicts local excess bounds. For binary functions, cyclic gap admissibility (2/3 always, 4 iff neighbouring gaps 1, and no gaps>4), combined with 3w-n=2a+b-c and c<=a, completely classifies gap words for deficit 0,1,2. Labelled cyclic enumeration yields stated counts. Direct exhaustive test n=5..18 and independently built cyclic transfer n=5..60 both match; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact multiplicities and explicit description of all optimum Italian functions of cycle squares strengthen an already known optimum into an invariant needed for recently studied Italian domination polynomials. The residue-class count has a genuine quadratic branch, and the n=5 and n=10 double-label exceptions reveal where 2-domination minima do not exhaust Italian minima. It is a complete infinite structural enumeration on a natural web-graph family, not a numerical lookup or renaming of the known gamma formula.
